_about: Coverage note shown with each month of the FORGE Map archive (tools/map_archive.py). One entry per month, keyed YYYY-MM. A month with pins but no entry here gets the default note in tools/map_archive.py. Changing a note gives that month's archive file a new name at the next publish. The owner approved the October 2026 note below as written, together with the map's empty-month note (EMPTY_MONTH_NOTE in publisher/templates/map.html), on 25 October 2026 before Batch 11. The default note in tools/map_archive.py was not part of that review.

2026-10.note: Collection began on 1 October 2026, and not every day of October was searched. An empty day means it was not searched or nothing was approved, not that nothing happened. These are hand-checked incidents from news reports, each linked to its sources. This is not a crime rate.
